about: Why each DTR test that did not pass did not pass. Rules are matched in order against the test id (and the message when given); the first match wins.

failures.cause: The kit checks the client assertion aud against the v2.0.1 suite token endpoint, not the v2.2.0 endpoint it advertises.
The kit's own $questionnaire-package response fails the kit's validation: no QuestionnaireResponse entry, and for the adaptive package no Bundle type and no entry fullUrl.
Two elements (item text and answer option rendering-xhtml) cannot be observed by the kit. The others are not in the questionnaires used in this run; Clear supplies questionnaires that hold them.
The questionnaires used in this run do not hold every must support element (enableWhen, enableWhenExpression). Clear supplies questionnaires that hold them.

notRun.reason: UDAP B2B option. This run used SMART Backend Services. Clear's UDAP client is in progress; DTR-02 applies to these tests once they run.
